options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Starting Characters
options.doc:
Determines your set of starting characters.

Characters omitted from "Include Characters" will not be included regardless of this option.

If a DLC option is chosen but the DLC is not enabled, an error will be raised during generation.

* Default All: Start with the default characters from the base game and all enabled DLCs.
* Random All: Start with random characters chosen from the base game and all enabled DLCs.
* Default Base Game: Start with Well Rounded, Brawler, Crazy, Ranger and Mage.
* Random Base Game: Start with random characters from the base game only.
* Default Abyssal Terrors: Start with Sailor, Curious, Builder, Captain, and Creature.
* Random Abyssal Terrors: Start with random characters from the Abyssal Terrors DLC.

options.name: Number of Progressive Wave Caps
options.doc:
The number of caps to put on the accessible waves.

You will not be able to play beyond the maximum wave cap until you find additional
Progressive Wave Cap items.

With one cap, all waves are accessible from the start.

With two caps, waves 1-10 are accessible from the start, and waves 11-20 require one
Progressive Wave Cap.

With four caps: waves 1-5 are accessible from the start, waves 6-10 require one
Progressive Wave Cap, waves 11-15 require two, waves 16-20 require 3.

Vous ne serez pas en mesure de jouer au-delà du plafond d'onde maximum jusqu'à ce que vous trouvez des éléments supplémentaires de plafond d'onde progressive.

options.name: Gold Reward Mode
options.doc:
Chooses how gold rewards are given.

#. One Time: Gold items are only given once, in either the current run or the next run after receiving the item.
#. All Every Time: The total amount of gold received is given to the player at the start of every run. Since gold is
   a filler item, this can lead to the game being "won" very easily early on in larger multiworlds.
options.doc_html:
Chooses how gold rewards are given.

  1. One Time: Gold items are only given once, in either the current run or the next run after receiving the item.
  2. All Every Time: The total amount of gold received is given to the player at the start of every run. Since gold is a filler item, this can lead to the game being "won" very easily early on in larger multiworlds.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez comment les récompenses d'or sont données.

#. One Time: Les items en or ne sont donnés qu'une seule fois, soit dans l'exécution courante, soit dans l'exécution suivante après réception de l'item.
#. All Every Time: La quantité totale d'or reçue est donnée au joueur au début de chaque course. Puisque l'or est un élément de remplissage, cela peut conduire au jeu étant "won" très facilement tôt dans les grands multimondes.

options.name: Include Elites in Logic
options.doc:
Sets whether to consider elites when determining game logic.

Elites appear at Danger 2 and higher, on either wave 11 or 12, or wave 14 or 15, with
the horde wave appearing in the other pair. At Danger 4, another elite appears on
wave 17 or 18.

This only affects when legendary loot crates are in logic.

* When disabled, legendary loot crates are not in logic until you can reach wave 20
  with any character and kill the boss.
* When enabled, legendary loot crates are in logic starting at wave 11. You are
  current subject to RNG on whether the elite will spawn there versus the horde.
options.doc_html:
Sets whether to consider elites when determining game logic.

Elites appear at Danger 2 and higher, on either wave 11 or 12, or wave 14 or 15, with the horde wave appearing in the other pair. At Danger 4, another elite appears on wave 17 or 18.

This only affects when legendary loot crates are in logic.

  • When disabled, legendary loot crates are not in logic until you can reach wave 20 with any character and kill the boss.
  • When enabled, legendary loot crates are in logic starting at wave 11. You are current subject to RNG on whether the elite will spawn there versus the horde.
options.doc_fr:
Définit s'il faut considérer les élites lors de la détermination de la logique de jeu.

Les Elites apparaissent à Danger 2 et plus, soit sur la vague 11 ou 12, soit sur la vague 14 ou 15, l'onde horde apparaissant dans l'autre paire. À Danger 4, une autre élite apparaît sur la vague 17 ou 18.

Cela n'affecte que lorsque les légendaires caisses de butin sont en logique.

* Lorsque désactivé, les caisses de pillage légendaires ne sont pas dans la logique jusqu'à ce que vous puissiez atteindre la vague 20 avec n'importe quel personnage et tuer le patron.
* Lorsqu'elles sont activées, les légendaires caisses de pillage sont en logique à partir de la vague 11. Vous êtes actuellement soumis à la RNG pour savoir si l'élite va y frayer contre la horde.

options.name: Spawn Normal Loot Crates
options.doc:
Sets whether loot crates can still spawn when connected to a multiworld.

If off, then the only consumables that spawn will be the health items and the Archipelago drop item. No regular or
legendary loot crates will spawn.

If on, then loot crates will still spawn when there are no available Archipelago drops. See 'Loot Crate Groups' for
details.

Définit si les caisses de pillage peuvent encore frayer lorsqu'elles sont connectées à un multimonde.

S'il est éteint, les seuls consommables qui frayent seront les articles de santé et l'élément de dépôt de l'archipel. Aucune caisse normale ou légendaire ne fraiera.

Si sur, alors les caisses de pillage frayeront quand il n'y a pas de gouttes d'archipel disponibles. Pour plus de détails, voir les « Groupes de caisses de paiement ».

options.name: Loot Crate Groups
options.doc:
The number of groups to separate loot crate locations into.

Once you check all the locations in a group, the randomizer will not drop more loot crate Archipelago items until
you win more runs.

The number of loot crate locations will be evenly split among the groups, and the groups will be evenly spread out
over the number of wins you choose.

Set to 1 to make all loot crate locations available from the start.

Le nombre d'emplacements de caisses de pillage sera également divisé entre les groupes, et les groupes seront répartis uniformément sur le nombre de victoires que vous choisissez.

options.name: Starting Shop Lock Buttons
options.doc:
Add the "Lock" buttons in the shop as items.

Missing buttons will be disabled until they are received as items.

The button and shop slot are different items, so it's possible to receive the button without the shop.

* All: Start with all lock buttons enabled (vanilla behavior).
* None: Start with no lock buttons enabled at start.
* Match shop slots: Start with the same number of lock buttons as shop slots.
* Custom: Choose the number to start with using "Number of Lock Buttons".
